TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi beforefieldinit SKGraphiteContext extends SkiaSharp.SKObject

Docs.summary: Represents a Skia Graphite GPU context that owns backend resources and executes recordings.

remarks.para: Create an instance with one of the backend factory methods (, , or ). A context creates recorders, inserts their recordings, and submits work to the GPU. Dispose the context to release its native resources.
